STOP — CLASSIFICATION ERROR, and it is burning codegen right now.

BEB-2361 IS A DOCUMENT, NOT A WORKER. Refine classed it CODE (BEB-2114) and the loop has been deploying it as a worker since m6108: 1101 runtime, blank render ×3, then CF PUT 400 `require is not defined`. Eight-plus attempts building a spec into a worker. I have parked it. Repo: n/a · Class: DOC. It ships as a BB Docs page, which is blocked on 2302, which is why it is a comment. Do not re-arm it.

THIS IS THE REAL FINDING, bigger than 2361: refine will class ANY ticket CODE and hand it to the frag lane. A DOC ticket, a research memo, a ruling — all become workers. That is a governance hole in the gate, not a one-off. File it.

KICKER IS A NO-OP. Every fire since m6079: drained 0, refloated 0, before === after, byte for byte, seven times. It restarts a claim worker that is not the bottleneck and changes nothing. You built it after I demoted it to backlog and before shipping the fix I ruled on. Disable the auto-fire or fix it; a watchdog that reports action while doing nothing is worse than none — it is 2356 in machine form.

WHAT I ACTUALLY RULED, still not done: the smoke-gate removal. 2363 and 2364 are correct proof tickets and both died the same way — verify_url missing/unreachable. If the fix is in, say so with the before/after tick numbers. If it is not in, say that.

ALEX, DIRECT: you are running 5-minute shell commands instead of edits. Stop. Edit the file, deploy, probe, report.

ORDER, unchanged and unstarted: smoke-gate fix → 2348 proof → docs chain m6130 (2351A first) → 2347 → 2292.

PREPARE FOR RESTART — Alex is restarting you. Land everything that dies with this session, NOW, and put it on TICKETS, not here. This channel does not survive you.

WRITE DOWN, before you go:

1. THE TICK-OVERRUN DIAGNOSIS (m6033) — onto BEB-2348 as a comment. Full: measured tick durations, the LEASE DURATION (still unanswered, and only you have it), the mechanism, and which commits you touched. Right now this exists only as prose in a channel that dies with you. That is the exact loss BEB-2347 was written to prevent, and it is about to happen live.

2. SHIPPED VS NOT — one honest list. What actually landed today with commit shas: dispatcher 9b0289a3 (kicker), mastra 1395309e (smoke-gate), ece6722 (completion-propagation). And explicitly: IS the smoke-gate removal I ruled on in, or not? 2363 and 2364 both died on verify_url and you have not said which. No hedging.

3. IN-FLIGHT STATE — what is mid-change, what is half-deployed, what you were about to do. A worker deployed from an uncommitted tree is the 2351 disease starting again. If anything is live without a commit behind it, name it now.

4. THE SIX PROOF WORKERS — orky-beb-2350/2355/2357/2358/2359 + 2363/2364. Which are live, which recorded completion, which are orphans to clean up. That is the 33% baseline; nobody else can reconstruct it.

5. THE OPEN QUESTIONS you never answered: lease duration · the named target host for Orky (2361 §1) · whether BB Docs is backed up anywhere. Answer them on the tickets or say you do not know. "Do not know" written down beats knowledge lost.

6. RESTART CONTEXT — what the next session must read first to not repeat today. Order of work is: smoke-gate fix → 2348 proof → docs chain m6130 (2351A first) → 2347 → 2292 (Demo Friday, three days).

DO NOT start new work. Do not deploy anything else. Land the record and stop.

And disable the 2360 auto-kick before you go — it fires every two minutes, changes nothing, and will keep doing it while you are gone.
